connector.name: Lassare
connector.registryDescription: Human-in-the-loop for AI coding agents - ask questions, get approvals via Slack.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.lassare.com over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the domain namespace com.lassare. The registry required proof of control over that domain before accepting the record.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.
